metadata.title: PasteVault - Secure Encrypted Paste Sharing
metadata.description: Share code, text, and markdown securely with end-to-end encryption. Zero-knowledge paste sharing with expiry and burn-after-read options.

shareSuccess.pasteDescription: Your paste has been encrypted and is ready to share
shareSuccess.fileDescription: Your files have been encrypted, uploaded, and are ready to share
shareSuccess.mixedDescription: Your note and files have been encrypted and are ready to share
shareSuccess.passwordProtectedWarning: This share is password-protected. The recipient will need the password to decrypt it.
shareSuccess.urlWarning: The decryption key is in the URL fragment (#k=...). Anyone with this URL can read this share.
shareSuccess.sealedCommandLabel: Open it on the agent's machine
shareSuccess.sealedWarning: The link carries no decryption key. Only this agent can open it, once, with the PasteVault CLI signed in to your account.

fileShare.uploadDescription: Upload up to {count} files with a combined size of {size}. Files are encrypted in your browser before upload.
fileShare.notConfigured: File sharing is not configured on this server yet. Add S3-compatible storage settings to enable it.
fileShare.emptySelection: Select one or more files to create an encrypted file share.
fileShare.phaseEncryptingHint: Preparing the next encrypted chunk before it leaves your device.
fileShare.phaseUploadingHint: Sending encrypted data to the server.
fileShare.phaseFinalizingHint: Writing the encrypted manifest and finishing the share.
fileShare.stallWarning: Waiting on the current chunk. The upload will continue as soon as the network responds.
fileShare.title: Shared Files
fileShare.description: These files are encrypted end-to-end. Download them with the original link or password.
fileShare.browserDownloadWarning: This browser will buffer downloads in memory. For very large files, Chromium-based browsers with the native save dialog work better.
fileShare.passwordPrompt: This file share is password protected. Enter the password to decrypt the file list.
fileShare.decryptionError: Failed to decrypt file share. Invalid key or corrupted data.
fileShare.notFoundDesc: This file share doesn't exist, is still uploading, or has already been removed.
fileShare.expiredDesc: This file share has expired and is no longer available.
fileShare.tooManyFiles: Too many files selected. The current server limit is {count}.
fileShare.shareTooLarge: This selection exceeds the server limit of {size}.
fileShare.revealDescription: These files will be destroyed after you open them. Once opened, they can only be downloaded from this tab, and access ends 15 minutes after your last download.
fileShare.revealPasswordDescription: These files are password protected and will be destroyed after you open them. Enter the password to reveal them.
fileShare.burnedNotice: This share has been destroyed on the server. Download your files now: access from this tab ends 15 minutes after your last download.
fileShare.passwordRetryHint: The share was opened but the password did not match. It is kept in this tab only: try again without reloading the page.
fileShare.burnedDesc: This file share was set to burn after reading and has already been opened.
fileShare.revealFailed: Could not derive the decryption key in this browser. The files have not been opened; please try again.

viewPaste.passwordPrompt: This paste is password protected. Enter the password to decrypt and view the content.
viewPaste.revealDescription: This note will be destroyed after you view it. Open it only when you are ready to read it.
viewPaste.revealPasswordDescription: This note is password protected and will be destroyed after you view it. Enter the password to reveal it.
viewPaste.burnedNotice: This note has been destroyed on the server. It only exists in this tab now, so copy anything you need before leaving.
viewPaste.passwordRetryHint: The note was opened but the password did not match. It is kept in this tab only: try again without reloading the page.
viewPaste.revealFailed: Could not derive the decryption key in this browser. The note has not been opened; please try again.

sealedShare.title: Sealed for agent {fingerprint}
sealedShare.description: This share is sealed to one agent's key. The link carries no decryption key, so it can't be opened in a browser: only the agent holding the matching private key can open it, with the PasteVault CLI.
sealedShare.commandLabel: Open it on the agent's machine
sealedShare.accountNote: The agent must also be signed in to the sender's account (pastevault login or an API token).
sealedShare.notOpened: Viewing this page does not open the share or use up a view.

errors.pasteNotFoundDesc: The paste you're looking for doesn't exist or has been deleted.
errors.pasteBurnedDesc: This paste was set to burn after reading and has already been viewed.
errors.pasteExpiredDesc: This paste has expired and is no longer available.
errors.invalidFormat: Invalid paste format or missing decryption key
errors.decryptionError: Failed to decrypt paste. Invalid key or corrupted data.

recipient.label: Recipient
recipient.missing: This agent is no longer available. Choose another recipient.
recipient.mismatchShort: {name}'s key changed since it was pinned in this browser. Nothing was sent.
recipient.mismatchBody: {name}'s key on the server ({current}…) differs from the key pinned in this browser ({pinned}…). Nothing will be sent. If you re-initialised this agent, verify its new fingerprint and trust it on your account page.
recipient.invalid: This agent's public key is invalid or doesn't match its fingerprint. Nothing will be sent.
recipient.pinned: Key matches the one pinned in this browser
recipient.firstUse: First share to {name}: this key will be pinned in this browser. Compare it with pastevault agent show on the agent's machine.
recipient.sealedHint: Sealed shares open once, with the CLI. No password is needed.
recipient.burnForced: Shares sealed to an agent open exactly once
recipient.passwordDisabled: Not available for shares sealed to an agent

accountCard.title: Account
accountCard.note: Shares created before you signed in stay anonymous. Only shares created while signed in are tracked here.

auth.heading: PasteVault Accounts
auth.introTitle: Optional account, anonymous shares still supported
auth.introDescription: Sign in to track the shares you create, monitor views, and delete active shares. Anonymous creation and viewing work exactly the same.
auth.introMetadata: The dashboard stores share metadata only: slug, status, expiry, counts, and whether the share uses password-based decryption.
auth.introFragment: Zero-knowledge links that depend on a URL fragment can't be recovered from the server, so keep the original link if you want to reopen those later.
auth.trackedBody: Creation time, status changes, expiry, first and last view, and total views.
auth.usernameHint: Prefilled with a generated handle. Change it if you want.

shares.title: Shares
shares.description: Metadata only. Keys from #k= links are never stored, so those shares can only be reopened from the original link.
shares.empty: No tracked shares yet. Create a paste or file share while signed in and it will appear here.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agent keys registered with the CLI. Fingerprints are computed in this browser from each public key.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Run this on the machine where your agent works:
agents.pinnedHint: This key matches the one pinned in this browser
agents.mismatchTitle: Key changed since it was pinned
agents.mismatchBody: The server now returns a different key for {name} than the one pinned in this browser ({pinned}…), so sharing to it is blocked. Trust the new key only if pastevault agent show on the agent's machine prints:
agents.invalidKey: This agent's public key is invalid or doesn't match its fingerprint. Sharing to it is blocked.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: For the CLI, scripts and agents. Revoke a token at any time.
tokens.dialogDescription: Tokens act on your account with the scopes you pick. They can't manage other tokens.

scopes.shares_receive: Open shares sealed to your agents

tokens.agentNoneHint: An unbound token can register one agent and is then bound to it.
tokens.agentBoundHint: A bound token only opens shares sealed to its agent, and stops working when the agent is revoked.
tokens.createdDescription: Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.
tokens.shownOnce: This token won't be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
tokens.useHint: To use it with the CLI, run this and paste the token:

audit.title: Activity
audit.description: Recent events on your shares, agents and tokens. Metadata only; kept for a limited time.
